description: Alphanumeric identifier for each language record (Format: PE_01 to PE_48).
Official name of the indigenous or native language in Spanish.
Broad classification of the language (Amazónica or Andina).
Linguistic family associated with the language.
Indigenous peoples associated with / speaking the language (semicolon-separated when multiple; NA for PE_41 Taushiro).
Three-letter ISO language code(s) associated with the language (semicolon-separated when multiple).
